Mashed Potatoes and Garlic
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:48am

Ingredients




2 pounds Potatoes, thin skin
1/2 teaspoon Celery seed, ground
1 Garlic bulb clove
Salt
 teaspoon Baking powder
4 tablespoons Butter, soft
1/2 cup Milk, hot
1/2 cup Cheddar cheese, grated

Preparation

1 Peel potatoes or leave skins on if they are very thin; fiber, you know. 2 Cover potatoes with water. Add salt to taste and celery seed. Separate garlic cloves from bulb. Slightly crush each clove with side of cleaver or bottom of heavy glass and peel. Cut garlic into thin slices and add to potatoes. Cover and boil until potatoes are soft. Place cover over pot and drain off water. Hold cover on pot tightly and vigorously shake potatoes to break them up. Beat with mixer. Add baking powder, milk, butter and cheese. 3 Beat until potatoes are fluffy. The baking powder makes the potatoes fluffier.
